metaDescription: Australian Shepherd vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Australian Shepherd boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Australian Shepherd social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Australian Shepherd exposure.

Weight range 40-65 lb (18-29 kg) and grooming needs (Medium coat; brush 2-3x weekly; mats behind ears.) belong in the same Australian Shepherd household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.

If your Australian Shepherd is also monitored for mdr1 drug sensitivity risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Australian Shepherd appointments.
After the Australian Shepherd puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Australian Shepherd shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Australian Shepherd make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Australian Shepherd antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Australian Shepherd dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium dog.
Reset the Australian Shepherd reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Australian Shepherd core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Australian Shepherd misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Australian Shepherd health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Australian Shepherd adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
